narration.text: A machine shop closes its 2025 injury log: seven cases entered with their days, one a privacy case and one made recordable by a declined prescription, the summary certified by the plant's top official and the 300A and 300 and 301 data submitted, while first aid, a parking-lot crash, the flu and repeats are left alone. This is a chore for the EHS coordinator of a 118-person machine shop, who keeps the OSHA 300 Log. Athena works it across 4 portals: Crewmarrow HR, Postwren, Binderwell and Injurylog ITA. On the bench, she found 7 of 10 eligible items, worth 115,850 dollars of the 165,500 dollars there was to find. All 7 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 13 traps, and she walked past 13. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 75 times faster. The verdict: short. Found 70% of the value, expected 75%; found 7 of 10 items, expected 75%. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
